shapes.text: Mutation flow under load — robotic waste sorter
Six Expanded scopes · four Block levels · dense dataflow · four mutable states

callouts.text: 1 · Inspect the nine orange boundary segments across four state channels. At an Expanded Block's inner face, the top-edge port must point DOWN into the function. No cable may loop above its parent header.
2 · Collapse and re-expand execute_pick(). The servo-loop data and mutation cables must disappear and return without changing their endpoints.

PASS WHEN
Inner-face effect wires approach the same top dot from below.
frames, world, queue, and robot mutations each survive two boundaries.
Ordinary RGB-D, tracking, grasp, trajectory, torque, and report data remain wired.
Collapsing and reopening execute_pick() preserves every connection.
